name: swagger-openapi-viewer
displayName: Swagger Editor & OpenAPI Editing (Lint, Spec Preview, 3.1)
description: Swagger editor and OpenAPI editor for VS Code: lint with readable rules and quick fixes, IntelliSense, $ref go to definition and rename, and a live Swagger UI preview that follows the cursor. OpenAPI 3.1, 3.0 and Swagger 2.0 in YAML or JSON, offline. Convert 2.0 to 3.0 to 3.1, bundle split specs. Also a Swagger viewer and OpenAPI viewer. No sign-in.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Try it out, the mock server and remote $refs stay off in Restricted Mode.

enumDescriptions: Swagger UI, or the reference layout for large specs (see openapiViewer.largeSpecMB)
Reference layout: list, details and examples side by side
openapiViewer.defaultLayout.description: Layout of a new preview. The toolbar switch changes it and is kept for this workspace.

openapiViewer.updateDelayMs.description: Wait this long after you stop typing before the preview updates. Files over 1 MB wait at least 800 ms, files over 4 MB at least 1.5 s.

openapiViewer.maxFileMB.description: Largest spec file (root or referenced) that is read, in MB.

openapiViewer.largeSpecMB.description: With the auto layout, specs larger than this (or with more than 600 operations) open in the reference layout, which draws one operation at a time.

enumDescriptions: Show a "Load remote refs" button when a spec has http(s) $refs. Nothing is loaded until you click it, and only for that file.
openapiViewer.remoteRefs.description: Remote $refs (http and https). Local and private network addresses are never loaded.

openapiViewer.tryItOut.description: Show "Try it out" in the Swagger UI layout. A request is sent by VS Code only after you click Execute and confirm the server, and only to hosts on openapiViewer.tryItOutAllowedHosts. Off by default: the preview makes no network requests.

openapiViewer.swaggerUi.docExpansion.description: What Swagger UI opens at first. Large specs always start closed.

openapiViewer.showProblemsInEditor.description: Also show the problems of an open preview in the Problems panel and as squiggles in the spec files.

openapiViewer.askForRating.description: Ask one time for a Marketplace rating after you have used OpenAPI Editor on a few files on different days. You can answer "Later" or "No thanks". Nothing is sent anywhere.

openapiViewer.showSupportLinks.description: Show the small Sponsor and More free viewers links at the bottom of the preview. Nothing is sent anywhere.

openapiViewer.lint.enabled.description: Lint OpenAPI and Swagger files with readable rules (operationId, descriptions, unused components, wrong $ref and more). Add a .spectral.yaml to the workspace folder to turn rules off or change their severity.

openapiViewer.lint.whenPreviewClosed.description: Also lint spec files that are open in an editor without a preview. Results go to the Problems panel.

openapiViewer.preview.followCursor.description: The preview shows the operation or schema under the cursor, and a click on an operation or schema in the preview moves the cursor to its line. The Follow cursor button in the preview toolbar changes this setting.

openapiViewer.tryItOutAllowedHosts.description: Hosts that Try it out may send requests to. *.example.com matches its subdomains. A request to another host is not sent; you are asked whether to add the host. Every new server is also confirmed once per preview.

openapiViewer.mock.port.description: Port of the mock server on 127.0.0.1. 0 picks a free port.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with the OpenAPI Editor
walkthroughs.description: Lint, edit and preview OpenAPI and Swagger files in VS Code, offline.

steps.title: Open a preview
steps.description:
Open a YAML or JSON file that starts with openapi: or swagger:. Click the preview button at the top right of the editor, or press Shift+Alt+P.
[Find a spec](command:workbench.action.quickOpen?%5B%22.yaml%22%5D)

media.altText: A spec with lint problems next to its live preview in VS Code.

steps.title: Lint and quick fixes
steps.description:
Problems in a spec show in the Problems panel with the rule name, for example operation-operationId. Press Ctrl+. (Cmd+. on macOS) on a squiggle for a quick fix, or turn a rule off in .spectral.yaml.
[Show Problems](command:workbench.actions.view.problems)

steps.title: Split specs and problems
steps.description: Relative $refs to other files are loaded from your workspace and kept up to date when you save them. The Problems list shows errors with file and line; click one to go there.

steps.title: Two layouts
steps.description:
Switch between Swagger UI and the reference layout in the toolbar. Large specs open in the reference layout.
[Open settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22openapiViewer%22%5D)

steps.title: Convert, bundle and compare
steps.description:
Right-click in a spec and open the OpenAPI menu: convert Swagger 2.0 to OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.0 to 3.1, bundle a split spec into one file, or compare with a git ref. Every change opens as a diff first.
[Convert to OpenAPI 3.1](command:openapiViewer.convertTo31)
